steps.title: Prepare PCR master mix
steps.instruction: In a PCR tube combine KOD One™ PCR Master Mix (Blue) 25 µL, Forward Primer 1.5 µL, Reverse Primer 1.5 µL, and DI Water 22 µL to a final volume of 50 µL.

steps.title: Mix and aliquot master mix
steps.instruction: Vortex the tube to mix thoroughly, then split the 50 µL solution equally into five new PCR tubes, adding 10 µL to each tube.

steps.title: Inoculate colonies into PCR tubes
steps.instruction: Using an inoculation loop, pick cells from each colony of interest and dunk the loop into the corresponding labeled PCR tube containing the 10 µL master mix.

steps.title: Run colony PCR
steps.instruction: Place the tubes in a thermal cycler and run the following program: 98 °C for 10 s (step 1), 55 °C for 5 s (step 2), 68 °C for 1 min (step 3); repeat steps 1‑3 for a total of 25 cycles, then hold at 68 °C (step 4).

steps.title: Perform gel electrophoresis
steps.instruction: After PCR completion, load the PCR products onto an agarose gel and run electrophoresis under the appropriate conditions.

steps.title: Image the agarose gel
steps.instruction: Place the gel onto a UV Sample Tray, insert it into the Gel Doc EZ System, and run the gel imaging program on the desktop.

steps.title: Save image and dispose gel
steps.instruction: Save the gel image file, then discard the used agarose gel into the biohazard bin.

steps.title: Check for expected band
steps.instruction: Examine the saved image to determine whether the expected PCR band is present.
